svg.title: EMS Co-Pilot
svg.desc: EMS Co-Pilot: Plant energy readings in, traceable energy and carbon reports out: deterministic SQLite analytics, a Gradio dashboard and optional AI drafts that cite source pages. 175,200 duplicate rows caught before reporting.
